local p = {}
local characterMap = mw.loadData('Module:InfoChar/Data')
local unitData = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')
local aoeData = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/AoE_Type') -- Load AoE data
local subData = require('Module:InfoChar/SubData')
local secondSubData = require('Module:InfoChar/2ndSubData') -- Load the new module

local function formatNumber(number)
    local isNegative = number < 0
    number = math.abs(number)

    -- Round to two decimal places
    number = math.floor(number * 100 + 0.5) / 100

    local formatted = tostring(number)
    local integer, decimal = formatted:match("([^.]+)%.?(.*)$")

    local result = ""
    local count = 0
    for i = #integer, 1, -1 do
        count = count + 1
        result = integer:sub(i,i) .. result
        if count % 3 == 0 and i > 1 then
            result = "," .. result
        end
    end

    if decimal ~= "" then
        result = result .. "." .. decimal
    end

    if isNegative then
        result = "-" .. result
    end

    return result
end

local function calculateDPS(unitData, characterMap, displayName)
    -- Find the data from character map
    local info = characterMap[displayName]
    if not info then
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Character not found in characterMap with display name: " .. displayName)
        return nil, false, "Character not found in characterMap."  --Also return false
    end

    local unitId = info.name
    local data = unitData[unitId]

    if not data then
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Unit data not found in unitData with ID: " .. unitId)
        return nil, false, "Unit data not found."  --Also return false
    end

	-- DPS Blacklist
    local dpsBlacklist = {
        ["erwin"] = true,  -- Commander
        ["wendy"] = true,
        ["leafa_evolved"] = true,
		-- Add other unit IDs to the blacklist here
    }

    -- Check if character is blacklisted from DPS calculation
    if dpsBlacklist[unitId] then
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Character " .. unitId .. " is blacklisted from DPS calculation.")
        return nil, false, "DPS calculation is disabled for this character."  --Also return false
    end


    local finalDamage
    local attackCooldown

    -- Get final damage and cooldown from upgrades if available
    if data.upgrade then
        local maxLevel = 0
        for level, upgradeData in pairs(data.upgrade) do
            if type(level) == "number" and level > maxLevel then
                maxLevel = level
            end
        end
        if maxLevel > 0 then
            finalDamage = data.upgrade[maxLevel].damage
            attackCooldown = data.upgrade[maxLevel].attack_cooldown or data.attack_cooldown
        else
            finalDamage = data.damage
            attackCooldown = data.attack_cooldown
        end
    else
        finalDamage = data.damage
        attackCooldown = data.attack_cooldown
    end

    if not finalDamage then
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Final damage not found for unit: " .. unitId)
        return nil, false, "Final damage not found." --Also return false
    end

    if not attackCooldown then
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Attack cooldown not found for unit: " .. unitId)
        return nil, false, "Attack cooldown not found." --Also return false
    end
     -- Get the attack name from unit data
    local attackName
    if data.upgrade and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade] and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack then
        attackName = data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack
    elseif data.primary_attack_no_upgrades then
        attackName = data.primary_attack_no_upgrades
    end
      --check DoT effect value
       local hasDot = false
        if attackName then
        local attackData = aoeData[attackName]
        if attackData and attackData.Effect then
            local effect = attackData.Effect
            if effect.Name == "Bleed" or effect.Name == "Burn" or 
               effect.Name == "Poison" or effect.Name == "Decay" then
                  hasDot = true
            end
        end
    end
        
    

    -- Calculate DoT damage if available
    local totalDamage = finalDamage
    local dotDamageText = ""  -- Initialize DoT damage string
    
    if attackName then
        local attackData = aoeData[attackName]
        if attackData and attackData.Effect then
            local effect = attackData.Effect
            if effect.Name == "Bleed" or effect.Name == "Burn" or 
               effect.Name == "Poison" or effect.Name == "Decay" then
                local tickDamage = finalDamage * effect.Multiplier
                local totalDotDamage = tickDamage * effect.Ticks
                totalDamage = finalDamage + totalDotDamage
                dotDamageText = string.format(" (including DoT: %s)", formatNumber(totalDotDamage))  -- Update DoT damage string
            end
        end
    end
    -- Calculate DPS (Damage Per Second)
    if attackCooldown and attackCooldown > 0 then
        local dps = totalDamage / attackCooldown
        -- Multiply by the specific number
        local multipliedDPS = dps * 9.20406514
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Calculated DPS = " .. tostring(multipliedDPS))
        return multipliedDPS, hasDot, dotDamageText
    else
        mw.log("calculateDPS: Invalid attackCooldown value.")
        return nil, false, "Invalid attackCooldown value."
    end
end


-- Standalone getCalculatedDPS function
function p.getCalculatedDPS(frame)
    local displayName = frame.args[1]
    if not displayName then
        return "Error: No character name provided."
    end

    local calculatedDPS, hasDot, dotDamageText = calculateDPS(unitData, characterMap, displayName)

    if calculatedDPS == nil and dotDamageText then
         return "Error: " .. dotDamageText
    end

    if calculatedDPS then
        return formatNumber(calculatedDPS) .. dotDamageText
    else
        return "Calculated DPS not available."
    end
end

function p.getName(id)
    local input = id.args[1] or ''

    -- Try finding by display name first
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == input then
            -- Return both name and description if available
            local result = displayName
            return result
        end
    end

    -- If not found by display name, try finding by ID
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if info.name == input then
            -- Return both name and description if available
            local result = displayName
        end
    end

    return "Character not found"
end

function p.getDesc(id)
    local input = id.args[1] or ''

    -- Try finding by display name first
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == input then
            local description = subData.getDescription(id, displayName)  -- Pass frame (id) and displayName
            if description then
                return description
         
            else
                return "Description not found"  -- Handle missing description
            end
        end
    end

    -- If not found by display name, try finding by ID
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if info.name == input then
            local description = subData.getDescription(id, displayName)  -- Pass frame (id) and displayName
            if description then
                return description
                
            else
                return "Description not found"  -- Handle missing description
            end
        end
    end

    return "Character not found"
end

function p.getDPS(frame)
    local input = frame.args[1] or ''
    local dot_note = ''

local function getCharacterDPS(displayName, info, frame)
    local customDPSData = subData.getCustomDPS(info.name)  -- Try to get custom data
    local calculatedDPS,hasDot, errorMessage = calculateDPS(unitData, characterMap, displayName)
       local manualPlacementCap = frame.args[4] -- Get the fourth argument, if given from the editor.
    local charData = secondSubData.getData(displayName)
          local manualDot = frame.args[5]

    mw.log("getCharacterDPS: calculatedDPS = " .. tostring(calculatedDPS) .. ", errorMessage = " .. tostring(errorMessage))

    -- Use custom data if available; otherwise, calculate it.
    local result = "" -- Initialize result to an empty string
    local extraText = ""

    if info.name == "alucard_evolved" then
        extraText = "<p>Summon HP: 12,234,940</p>"
    end
    local unitId = info.name
    local data = unitData[unitId]
    
    if customDPSData then
       -- Check if result is table or string, if table then concat it with <br>
            if customDPSData.formattedText and customDPSData.formattedText ~= "" then
                  result = frame:preprocess(customDPSData.formattedText) -- Applying preprocess here
                    if type(customDPSData.formattedText) == 'table' then
                    	local formattedText = table.concat(customDPSData.formattedText, "<br>")
                result = frame:preprocess(formattedText)
                else
                result = frame:preprocess(customDPSData.formattedText)
                end
             end
    elseif unitId == "judar_evo" or unitId == "vanilla_ice_evo" or unitId == "feitan_evo" then
       if info.dps then
           local dps = tonumber(info.dps)
           local dpm = dps * 60
           local total_dps, total_dpm

           local spawnCap = unitData[info.name] and unitData[info.name].spawn_cap  
           if not spawnCap then
              spawnCap = 1
           end
           local placement = tonumber(manualPlacementCap) or tonumber(info.placement_cap) or spawnCap

           if placement and placement > 1 then
               total_dps = dps * placement
               total_dpm = dpm * placement
           end

           result = string.format(
               "DPS: %s<br>DPM: %s",
               formatNumber(dps),
               formatNumber(dpm)
           )

           if total_dps then
               result = result .. string.format(
                   "<br>Total DPS: %s<br>Total DPM: %s",
                   formatNumber(total_dps),
                   formatNumber(total_dpm)
               )
           end
        end
     else
            local dpsValue = calculatedDPS or (info.dps ~= "n/a" and info.dps) or nil

            mw.log("getCharacterDPS: dpsValue (after fallback)=" .. tostring(dpsValue) .. " for " .. displayName)

            if not (dpsValue and dpsValue ~= "n/a") then
                mw.log("getCharacterDPS: No DPS data available for " .. displayName)
                return ""  -- No DPS data available
            end
             if dpsValue then
            local dps = tonumber(dpsValue)
            local dpm = dps * 60
            local total_dps, total_dpm
            --Check the spanw cap and get the value from it.
              local spawnCap = unitData[info.name] and unitData[info.name].spawn_cap  --Get spawn cap from the function.
             if not spawnCap then
                spawnCap = 1
            end
              local placement = tonumber(manualPlacementCap) or tonumber(info.placement_cap) or spawnCap --GET THE PLACEMENT

            if placement and placement > 1 then
                total_dps = dps * placement
                total_dpm = dpm * placement
            end

            local formatted_result = string.format(
                "DPS: %s<br>DPM: %s",
                formatNumber(dps),
                formatNumber(dpm)
            )

            if total_dps then
                formatted_result = formatted_result .. string.format(
                    "<br>Total DPS: %s<br>Total DPM: %s",
                    formatNumber(total_dps),
                    formatNumber(total_dpm)
                )
            end

            result = formatted_result
              else
                return ""
            end
        end

  --Prepare dot_note BEFORE the DPS information
   local useDot = (manualDot ~= nil and manualDot ~= "n/a") or (charData and charData.dot_dmg == 'true') or hasDot
     if useDot then
        local proc_desc = frame:preprocess(string.format("<p>'''[NOTE: Unit's DPS INCULUDES the unit DoT damage.]'''</p>"))
        dot_note = proc_desc
    end

    --Special case for buddha_evo to always show dot_note
        if info.name == "buddha_evo" or info.name == "osaragi_evo" or info.name == "feitan_evo" or info.name == "hanako-kun_evo" then
            local proc_desc = frame:preprocess(string.format("<p>'''[NOTE: Unit's DPS INCULUDES the unit DoT damage.]'''</p>"))
            dot_note = proc_desc
        end
         if info.name == "nagumo_evo" then
            local proc_desc = frame:preprocess(string.format("<p>'''[NOTE: Unit's DPS INCLUDES the additional average DPS with CRIT.]'''</p>"))
            dot_note = proc_desc
        end

    return extraText .. result .. dot_note
end


    -- Try finding by display name first
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        mw.log("p.getDPS: Found by Display Name: " .. displayName)
        if displayName == input then
            return getCharacterDPS(displayName, info, frame)
        end
    end

    -- Try finding by ID
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
         mw.log("p.getDPS: Found by IdName: " .. info.name)
        if info.name == input then
            return getCharacterDPS(displayName, info, frame)
        end
    end

    mw.log("p.getDPS: Character not found: " .. input)
    return "Character not found"
end
--Spawn Cap Code
local function gSC(unitData, characterMap, displayName)
    -- Find the data from unitData
    local info = characterMap[displayName]

    if not info then
        mw.log("gSC: Character not found in characterMap with display name: " .. displayName)
        return ""
    end

    local unitId = info.name  -- Get unit ID from characterMap

    -- NEW: Prioritize manual placement_cap for feitan_evo
    if unitId == "feitan_evo" and info.placement_cap then
        return string.format("Placement Cap: %s", tostring(info.placement_cap))
    end
    
    local data = unitData[unitId]

    if not data then
        mw.log("gSC: Unit data not found in unitData with characterId: " .. unitId)
        local spawnCap = info.placement_cap
        if not spawnCap then
            mw.log("gSC: spawnCap data not found with characterId: " .. unitId)
            return ""
        else
            return string.format("Placement Cap: %s", tostring(spawnCap or "N/A"))
        end
    end

    local spawnCap = data.spawn_cap
    if not spawnCap then
        mw.log("gSC: spawnCap data not found with characterId: " .. unitId)
        return ""
    else
        return string.format("Placement Cap: %s", tostring(spawnCap or "N/A"))
    end
end

function p.gSC(frame)
    local characterName = frame.args[1]

    if not characterName then
        return "Character name must be specified."
    end

    return gSC(unitData, characterMap, characterName)
end

function p.getExtra(frame)
    local input = frame.args[1] or ''

    -- Try finding by display name first
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == input then
            local sections = {}
             local charData = secondSubData.getData(displayName) -- Get character data from 2ndSubData
              local unitInfo = characterMap[displayName]
             local unitId = unitInfo.name
              local data = unitData[unitId]

            -- Check if character data exists
            if charData then
                -- Format curse images only if curse1 exists and isn't n/a
                if charData.curse1 and charData.curse1 ~= "n/a" then
                    local curse_str = string.format("[[Image:%s icon.png|18px]]", charData.curse1)
                    if charData.curse2 and charData.curse2 ~= "n/a" then
                        curse_str = curse_str .. " [[Image:" .. charData.curse2 .. " icon.png|18px]]"
                    end
                    sections[#sections + 1] = string.format("Curse: %s", curse_str)
                end

                -- Format relics, excluding "n/a"

                if charData.relic1 and charData.relic1 ~= "n/a" then
                    relics_str = frame:preprocess(string.format("{{Item|%s}}", charData.relic1))
                end
                if charData.relic2 and charData.relic2 ~= "n/a" then
                    if relics_str ~= "" then relics_str = relics_str .. " " end
                    relics_str = relics_str .. frame:preprocess(string.format("{{Item|%s}}", charData.relic2))
                end
                if charData.relic3 and charData.relic3 ~= "n/a" then

                     if charData.trait4 and charData.trait4 ~= "n/a" then

                    end
                    sections[#sections + 1] = string.format("Traits: %s", traits_str)

            end

        end
    end

    -- If not found by display name, try finding by ID
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do

          local sections = {}
             local charData = secondSubData.getData(displayName) -- Get character data from 2ndSubData
               local unitInfo = characterMap[displayName]

            -- Check if character data exists

                    end

                end

                end

                end
                if relics_str ~= "" then
                    sections[#sections + 1] = string.format("Relics: %s", relics_str)
                end

                -- Format traits if trait1 exists and isn't n/a
                if charData.trait1 and charData.trait1 ~= "n/a" then
                    local traits_str = string.format("[[Image:Trait %s.png|18px]]", charData.trait1)
                    if charData.trait2 and charData.trait2 ~= "n/a" then
                        traits_str = traits_str .. " [[Image:Trait " .. charData.trait2 .. ".png|18px]]"
                    end
                    if charData.trait3 and charData.trait3 ~= "n/a" then

                    sections[#sections + 1] = string.format("Traits: %s", traits_str)

            end
            

            -- Only return Recommended section if there are sections to show
            if #sections > 0 then
                return "'''Recommended'''<br>" .. table.concat(sections, "<br>")
            end
            return "" -- Return empty string if no sections to show
        end
    end

    return "Character not found"
end

function p.getCost(frame)
	local function fn(number)
    if number >= 1000 then
        return string.format("%.2fK", number/1000)
    else
        return string.format("%.0f", number)
    end
end
    local input = frame.args[1] or ''
    local unitInfo

   --Blacklist table
    local blacklist = {
        ["frieren_evo"] = true,
        ["buddha_evo"] = true,
        ["nagumo_evo"] = true,
        ["feitan_evo"] = true,
        ["osaragi_evo"] = true,
        ["gaku_evo"] = true,
        ["sakamoto_evo"] = true,
        ["aizen_transcended"] = true,
        ["honey_evo"] = true,
        ["grimmjow_2_evo"] = true,
        ["gremmy_evo"] = true,
        ["vanilla_ice_evo"] = true,
        ["judar_evo"] = true,
    }


    -- Try finding by display name first
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == input then
            unitInfo = info
            break
        end
    end

    -- If not found by display name, try finding by ID
    if not unitInfo then
        for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
            if info.name == input then
                unitInfo = info
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not unitInfo then
        return ""
    end

	-- Check if the character is in the blacklist
    if blacklist[unitInfo.name] then
        return "" -- Return empty string if character is blacklisted
    end


    local unitId = unitInfo.name
    local data = unitData[unitId]

    if not data then
        return ""
    end

    local placementCost = data.cost
    local totalUpgradeCost = placementCost or 0

    if data.upgrade then
        for _, upgradeData in pairs(data.upgrade) do
            if upgradeData.cost then
                totalUpgradeCost = totalUpgradeCost + upgradeData.cost
            end
        end
    end

    local output = {}

    if placementCost then
        output[#output + 1] = string.format("Placement Cost: {{Yen|%s}}", fn(placementCost))
    end

    if totalUpgradeCost and totalUpgradeCost > 0 then
    	if unitId == "femto" then
    		 output[#output + 1] = string.format("Total Up. Cost: {{Yen|100K (∞)}}")
    		else
        output[#output + 1] = string.format("Total Up. Cost: {{Yen|%s}}", fn(totalUpgradeCost))
    	end
end

    if #output > 0 then
        return table.concat(output, "<br>")
    else
        return "Cost data not available"
    end
end


return p
